sloka: नलिन्यो ध्वस्त कमलाः त्रस्त मीन जले चराः ।सखीम् इव गत उत्साहाम् शोचन्ति इव स्म मैथिलीम् ॥३-५२-३५॥
transliteration: nalinyo dhvasta kamalāḥ trasta mīna jale carāḥ ।sakhīm iva gata utsāhām śocanti iva sma maithilīm ॥3-52-35॥

translations.english: Lotusponds with withering lotuses and with disturbed aquatic life like fishes in fright were as if grieving for Sita as one would grieve for a companion who is unable to breathe.
